correctness.rationale: For t>=109 the three sum bands [2,6], [t-46,t+14], [2t-94,2t+22] are disjoint; within each, equal pair sums and singleton pairs depend only on the ten offsets, so the same complete relation matrix applies for all t. Independent generation of all legal singleton-vs-pair and pair-vs-pair relations at t=109 gives thirteen 13-column rows. Independent exact Smith form has ten 1s and a 3 (rank11), cokernel Z^2⊕Z/3; all thirteen one-generator deletions regenerated from scratch have only unit nonzero Smith factors. Checked several separated parameters as corroboration; band-separation argument handles infinitely many. Read Tang–Yau step-word and insertion-homotopy constructions: integral chain contracting relation ∂h+h∂=z-1 leads to an integral quotient of the infinite translation complex; n>2(t+11) prevents two-step modular aliasing, so the relation cokernel represents regular GLMY H1. The key all-parameter statement is not deduced from finite samples.
residual_risks: The present independent test verifies complete integer short-relation Smith forms, not a formal mechanized proof of the integral Laurent-chain quotient. The all-moduli H1 identification relies on the written chain-homotopy argument and its correct regular-path restriction.
